body:
![TITLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fb22c93a73b1feb8ee3ad9d5636ec74971f8e1d_0.webp)

Welcome to Plenty O' Advancements! This mod adds additional advancements, creating a nicer experience and allowing people to hunt more advancements.

- Level 4 Operators are allowed to use this command, */plentyoadvancements:getalladvancements*

# Installation Guide
This mod uses **Neoforge**, so you have to install latest version on neoforge and 1.21.4 on Minecraft Version. --/ [https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge](https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge).

# Q&A
1. What is the perpose for me to download this mod?
- I made this mod as a test to see if I have creativity to make mode updates.

2. Why do you want to make this mod?
- I wanted to make this mod since I need to try something better and learn more skills for a 13 Y/o.

3. Why is the titled has it named from "Remake"?
- I named it with "Remake" because I worked on a testing version, I was suppose to figure it out to rename my work but I was playing around with the modding software, where I accidentally corrupted my work. Rendering it **useless**.
